content.title: AEW Revolution 2026: Live Zero Hour & match card preview
content.text: PublishedMar 15, 2026 at 06:47 PM EDTupdatedMar 15, 2026 at 08:21 PM EDTAEW "Revolution 2026" is a sellout at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, and there will be a special "Zero Hour" preshow before the pay-per-view begins. Three matches are set for the "Zero Hour" portion of "Revolution 2026." The AEW National Championship will be up for grabs in the Blackjack battle royal.Also featured on the preshow will be a TBS Championship match. Titleholder Willow Nightingale will defend against Lena Kross. Later on in the PPV portion of "Revolution," Nightingale and Harley Cameron will put the AEW Women's World Tag Team Championship at stake against Kross and Megan Bayne.Fans will also get to see "Big Boom" A.J. team up with QT Marshall to take on Capt. Shawn Dean and Carlie Bravo of The Infantry. A.J. and Marshall will be accompanied by Big Justice, while The Infantry will be led to the ring by Shane Taylor and Trish Adora.Willow Nightingale captures the AEW TBS Championship after pinning Mercedes Mone (via AEW).More News: Pro Wrestling Referee Suffers Brain Injury During Match, Update on HealthAEW Revolution 2026 PPV CardThere are high stakes involved in the matches scheduled for AEW "Revolution 2026." If "Hangman" Adam Page fails to defeat MJF in the main event Texas Deathmatch, he can never challenge for the AEW World Championship again. In the women's world title match, Thekla will defend against Kris Statlander under two-of-three-falls rules.There are several other marquee matches set for the event, such as FTR defending the AEW World Tag Team Championship against The Young Bucks. AEW Continental Champion Jon Moxley will be putting his gold on the line against Konosuke Takeshita.Here's the rest of the AEW "Revolution 2026" PPV lineup.Texas Deathmatch: MJF (c) vs. "Hangman" Adam Page - for the AEW World ChampionshipTwo of Three Falls: Thekla (c) vs. Kris Statlander - for the AEW Women's World ChampionshipFTR (c) vs. The Young Bucks - for the AEW World Tag Team ChampionshipJon Moxley (c) vs. Konosuke Takeshita - for the AEW Continental ChampionshipThe Babes of Wrath (c) vs. Megan Bayne and Lena Kross - for the AEW Women's World Tag Team ChampionshipAndrade El Idolo vs. BandidoSwerve Strickland vs. Brody KingKazuchika Okada, Kyle Fletcher, and Mark Davis (c) vs. Mistico and JetSpeed - for the AEW World Trios Championship"Timeless" Toni Storm vs. Marina Shafir Darby Allin, Orange Cassidy, and Roderick Strong vs. David Finlay, Gabe Kidd, and Clark ConnorsZero Hour Live StreamThe AEW "Revolution 2026" live stream for the "Zero Hour" portion of the event will air live at 7 p.m. ET. It'll be an hour of matches and previews before the PPV begins at 8 p.m. ET.More News:WWE’s Plan for Iyo Sky at WrestleMania 42 Could be TweakedWWE Has Key Plan for Giulia and Tiffany Stratton at WrestleMania 42 (Report)WWE Parts Ways With Longtime Creative Writer and Hall of FamerFor more on AEW content, head to Newsweek Sports.
